text: Reviews a diff against base branch for SQL safety, LLM trust-boundary violations, and other structural issues
quote: Analyzes diff against the base branch for SQL safety, LLM trust boundary violations, conditional side effects, and other structural issues.

text: Runs QA tests then iteratively fixes bugs, committing each fix atomically and re-verifying
quote: Runs QA testing, then iteratively fixes bugs in source code, committing each fix atomically and re-verifying.

text: Automated ship workflow: merge base, run tests, review diff, bump version, update changelog, commit, push, open PR
quote: Ship workflow: detect + merge base branch, run tests, review diff, bump VERSION, update CHANGELOG, commit, push, create PR.

text: Startup-mode skill asks six forcing questions to pressure-test a product idea before coding
quote: Startup mode: six forcing questions that expose demand reality, status quo, desperate specificity, narrowest wedge, observation, and future-fit.

text: Auto-review pipeline runs CEO, design, eng, and DX review skills sequentially with automated decisions
quote: Auto-review pipeline — reads the full CEO, design, eng, and DX review skills from disk and runs them sequentially with auto-decisions using 6 decision principles.

text: Security review skill finds exploitable defects by modeling attacker, boundary, impact, and challenge
quote: Find exploitable defects. State attacker, boundary, impact, and challenge.

text: Detects whether install is global or vendored, runs the upgrade, and shows what changed
quote: Detects global vs vendored install, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new.

text: Lets you review, search, prune, and export knowledge gstack has learned across sessions
quote: Review, search, prune, and export what gstack has learned across sessions.

text: Caches a codified script from a prior scrape so repeat requests replay in ~200ms instead of re-driving the page
quote: Future /scrape calls with the same intent run the codified script in ~200ms instead of re-driving the page.

text: Agent writes per-site notes/skills that compound over time and get injected into future session context
quote: Per-site notes the agent writes for itself. Compounds across sessions: once an agent figures out something non-obvious about a website, it saves a skill, and future sessions on that host get the note injected into their prompt context.

text: Can promote an active per-project skill to global, cross-project scope
quote: Promote an active per-project skill to global (cross-project)

text: Adding support for a new host requires only creating one file and re-exporting, no core code changes
quote: Adding a new host means creating one file and re-exporting it. Zero code changes to the generator, setup, or tooling.

text: Supports many AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Slate, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, GBrain) via typed config objects
quote: Each supported AI coding agent (Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Slate, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, GBrain) is defined as a typed TypeScript config object

text: Automatically falls back to a self-shipped persistent headless Chromium daemon when no local browser app is running
quote: When Aside is not installed or not running — Linux, Windows, a closed Aside app — gstack falls back, automatically, to the browser it ships itself: a persistent headless Chromium daemon behind a compiled CLI ($B).

text: Automates the user's own real browser session (cookies, logins, open tabs) rather than a simulated one
quote: real cookies, real logged-in accounts, the tabs they already have open

text: Dev mode symlinks the repo into the local skills directory so the agent reads skills straight from the checkout
quote: That's what dev mode does. It symlinks your repo into the local `.claude/skills/` directory so Claude Code reads skills straight from your checkout.

text: Routes any request to the right skill among planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, and design
quote: Sends any gstack request to the right skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, design).

text: Interactive plan-mode design review scores each dimension 0-10 and helps fix the plan
quote: Interactive plan-mode design review. Rates each dimension 0-10, explains what a 10 looks like, fixes the plan.

text: Can build a complete design system from scratch, including realistic product mockups
quote: Build a complete design system from scratch. Knows the landscape, proposes creative risks, generates realistic product mockups.

text: Turns vague intent into a precise, executable, backlog-ready spec through a five-phase process
quote: Turn vague intent into a precise, executable spec in five phases. Backlog-ready output that downstream skills can pick up.

text: Systematic root-cause debugging skill that forbids fixes without investigation and stops after 3 failed attempts
quote: Systematic root-cause debugging. Iron Law: no fixes without investigation. Traces data flow, tests hypotheses, stops after 3 failed fixes.

text: Locks in architecture, data flow, diagrams, edge cases, and tests to surface hidden assumptions
quote: Lock in architecture, data flow, diagrams, edge cases, and tests. Forces hidden assumptions into the open.

text: Terminal-driven checks react immediately to new output instead of polling at fixed intervals
quote: Terminal-driven checks react to new output instead of waiting through a fixed polling interval.
